title: CRISPR GENome and epigenome engineering (CRISPRgenee) improves loss-of-function genetic-screening approaches
model: TF-1 erythroleukemia (ZIM3-Cas9), dual-sgRNA CRISPRgenee chromatin library (1,137 genes)
contrast: Day 14 vs plasmid sgRNA pool (3 vs 3)
paper_calls: Positive controls (RPA3, MYC, CSF2RA) and essential genes drop out
named_hits: CSF2RA, MYC, RPA3, KDM1A, SETD8, ADAR all strongly depleted (FDR < 1e-4)
verdict: Raw reads recovered exactly from the normalized table. BARCS recovers every positive control and the essential-gene dropout signal, confirming the methods-paper screen performs as designed.
count_recovery: Raw reads = normalized / (one scale factor per sample); integrality 100.0%.
